## Requirements

R1: Every name that a module under `dashboard/` or `tests/` imports from `dashboard.model` still resolves from `dashboard.model`.
R2: `load_snapshot` is defined outside `dashboard/model/__init__.py`.
R3: `load_task_detail` is defined outside `dashboard/model/__init__.py`.
R4: `load_phase_detail` is defined outside `dashboard/model/__init__.py`.
R5: `load_decision_log` is defined outside `dashboard/model/__init__.py`.
R6: `load_requirement_detail` is defined outside `dashboard/model/__init__.py`.
R7: `NeedsYouDetailScreen` is defined outside `dashboard/app.py`.
R8: `BacklogDetailScreen` is defined outside `dashboard/app.py`.
R9: `PhasePickerScreen` is defined outside `dashboard/app.py`.
R10: `KeyHelpScreen` is defined outside `dashboard/app.py`.
R11: `NeedsConfirmModal` is defined outside `dashboard/app.py`.
R12: No module under `dashboard/model/` imports `textual`.
R13: No module under `dashboard/model/` imports `rich`.
R14: `DashboardApp` is defined in `dashboard/app.py`.
R15: `tests/test_dashboard_model.py` passes.
R16: `tests/test_dashboard_app.py` passes.
R17: `tests/test_dashboard_phase_screen.py` passes.
R18: `tests/test_dashboard_requirement.py` passes.
R19: `tests/test_dashboard_tasks.py` passes.
R20: `tests/test_dashboard_journal.py` passes.
R21: `tests/test_dashboard_milestones.py` passes.
R22: `tests/test_dashboard_status.py` passes.
R23: `tests/test_dashboard_gates.py` passes.
R24: `tests/test_dashboard_estimate.py` passes.
R25: `tests/test_dashboard_pager.py` passes.
R26: `tests/test_dashboard_launcher.py` passes.
R27: `tests/test_dashboard_integration.py` passes.
R28: `tests/test_dashboard_uv_env.py` passes.
R29: `tests/test_web_dashboard.py` passes.
R30: `tests/test_web_fastapi_writes.py` passes.
R31: `tests/test_web_dashboard_launch.py` passes.
R32: `tests/test_proof_dashboard.py` passes.

## Acceptance criteria

- R1: an import of each name currently imported from `dashboard.model` succeeds.
- R2 to R6: a scan of the defining module for each loader.
- R7 to R11 and R14: a scan of the defining file for each class.
- R12 and R13: a scan of imports under `dashboard/model/`.
- R15 to R32: those pytest modules pass.

## Constraints

- The split stays inside the `dashboard` package.
- `dashboard/model.py` is replaced by the `dashboard/model/` package. There is no `dashboard/model.py` beside that package.
- `DashboardApp` stays in `dashboard/app.py`. Widgets that belong to a moved screen move with that screen.

## Non-goals

- A change to what the Textual app or the web launcher shows.
- Colocating a Textual screen in the same module as its row types.
- Splitting `dashboard/web/` in this phase.
- A line-count target.

## Invariants

- Modules under `dashboard/model/` do not import Textual or Rich.
- Existing `import dashboard.model` and `from dashboard.model import ...` sites keep working through the package facade.

## Assumptions

- `wheel-contents` and `shared-helpers` have landed. The route table from `shared-helpers` stays in `dashboard/web/`.
- The public names of the loaders and row types stay the same.
